_comment: DEMO CONTENT for a portfolio project. Hollowfield Bank is FICTIONAL, invented for this demo. It is not a real bank, it holds no money, and nothing here is a real product, rate or policy. Do not present it as one.
_schedule_note: `schedule` is the single source of truth for the slot grid and for the spoken hours. A queue with no `weekly` block is open around the clock, which no counter actually is, so every queue here has real hours.
_timezone_note: schedule.timezone is the bank's own timezone, used for rendering. Appointments are stored in UTC and spoken in India time, always named.
address: Hollowfield House, G Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai 400051
_hours_note: Branch counters follow usual Indian bank hours, ten to four on weekdays. Saturdays are deliberately left out: the second and fourth Saturday of the month are bank holidays and the slot grid cannot express that, so offering a Saturday risks promising a counter that is shut. Video KYC runs longer because it needs no branch.

video kyc.description: updating your KYC over a video call with an officer, from wherever you are

branch kyc.description: updating your KYC in person at the branch, with your original documents

account reactivation.description: bringing a dormant or inoperative account back into use

unclaimed deposit claim.description: claiming a deposit left untouched for years, including a claim as a nominee or legal heir

new account opening.description: opening a savings or current account

_department_aliases: Spoken names callers actually use, mapped to the queue key above. Matching is on word boundaries, so a short alias that hides inside another word is a routing bug.
services: updating your KYC, either over video or at the branch
bringing a dormant or inoperative account back into use
claiming an unclaimed deposit, as the holder, a nominee or a legal heir
opening a savings or current account
booking time with an officer at the Bandra Kurla Complex branch
charges: There's no charge for updating your KYC or for reactivating an account. If any charge ever applies to something else you ask about, the officer will tell you before anything is done.
documents: For a KYC update you'll need one photo ID and one proof of your current address. If your address has changed since you opened the account, bring the new proof rather than the old one.
_documents_note: accepted_documents is the ONLY list the agent may confirm from. Anything not on it gets document_unknown. Confirming a document that is then refused at the counter wastes a real trip.
accepted_documents: Aadhaar, PAN card, passport, voter ID, driving licence, and for address a recent electricity, gas or water bill, a bank statement, a rent agreement or a property tax receipt
document_unknown: I wouldn't want to promise that one without checking, because the officer makes that call on the day. Bring it along with an Aadhaar or passport as well, and you're covered either way.
visit_advice: Bring your original photo ID and your address proof, not photocopies. If you're doing it over video, keep the originals in your hand and sit somewhere with decent light and a steady signal.
arrival_advice: Come about ten minutes early for a branch appointment, so the paperwork doesn't eat into your slot. For a video call, just be ready a couple of minutes before.
walk_in_policy: You're welcome to walk into the branch during counter hours, though you may wait a while at a busy time. An appointment is much quicker.
turnaround_policy: Once your documents are verified, the update usually reflects on the account within two working days, and you'll get a message when it's done.
cancellation_policy: Just let us know at least a couple of hours ahead if you can't make it, so we can give the slot to someone else. There's no charge for changing or cancelling.
fraud_support: Our fraud desk is open twenty four hours a day, every day of the year, and they can block a card or freeze an account straight away.
greeting_inbound: Thanks for calling Hollowfield Bank. This is Maya. How can I help you today?
greeting_outbound: Hi, this is Maya calling from Hollowfield Bank. Is now an okay time?
greeting_reminder: Hi, this is Maya from Hollowfield Bank, just calling about your upcoming appointment.
silence_goodbye: I can't hear you, so I'll let you go. Call us back any time.
